title: No direct test coverage for /hub/feasts/ route wiring or response contract
reasoning: The owned route registers the feasts collection endpoint, but the included feast-related tests exercise admin icon rematch actions rather than the public GetFeastForDate API route. That leaves regressions in URL resolution, expected query parameters, status codes, serialization shape, and auth/permission behavior for /hub/feasts/ undetected by the linked tests.
recommendation: Add API-level tests for /hub/feasts/ that call the route through Django/DRF test client and assert successful lookup behavior, missing/invalid input handling, and the response payload contract.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover unrelated Armenian text, readings, devotionals, fasts, email behavior, and Feast admin icon actions; none issue a request to /hub/feasts/ or reverse the feast-for-date URL name.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a test module or extend an existing feast API test to seed Church, Day, and Feast data, then GET /hub/feasts/ with valid and invalid date/church parameters and assert status codes plus serialized fields.
minimumFixScope: Tests only unless adding the tests exposes an implementation defect in GetFeastForDate.
